title: Pullback metrics and homological obstructions to BLD remetrization of branched covers
summary: We characterize admissible BLD remetrizations of branched self-covers of spheres by linear local contractibility of their canonical pullback length metrics. A relative homology obstruction involving the total degree of an inverse image component yields uniform porosity of branch values. Explicit degree-two cusp covers of $\mathbb S^n$, $n\ge3$, have uniformly porous branch values of Hausdorff dimension $n-2$ but admit no compatible Ahlfors $n$-regular, linearly locally contractible BLD source metric.
